text:
Marco: throwing an idea on the wall: scrub + sampling means we often can't correlate a sampled log to the original field that triggered a bug. ops struggle to reproduce. propose a 'fieldline' id pattern for replay-safe correlation.
Priya: fieldline id = ? how is this different from the salted hash stuff we debated last quarter?
Marco: it's similar but tenant-scoped and explicitly designed for replay workflows. compute a deterministic HMAC per sensitive field using tenant KMS key. store the hex id alongside the redacted field. no reversible mapping.
Sam: won't that still prevent exact replays? many debuggers need the exact original payload to reproduce flaky behavior.
Marco: yes. goal isn't to expose raw PII in day-to-day debugging. instead: generate a deterministic surrogate from the fieldline id + schema so debug replays run with realistic-but-fake inputs.
Katie: can you sketch how the surrogate generation would work?
Marco: simple deterministic PRNG seeded by field_id and field-type rules. e.g., email -> fake@tenantdomain.example constructed with preserved domain pattern; phone -> random digits matching formatting; names -> choose from phony-name list while keeping gender-neutral mapping optional.
Juli: ops: we need a safe unredact path for legal/audit requests. we already have a breakglass but it's limited.
Sam: second: sampling. when we only keep 1% of requests, having fieldline ids means we can join metrics/traces for the same logical entity across samples. otherwise traces look orphaned.
Priya: good point. join key size should be small. 32-64 hex is fine. store in logs + metrics.
Katie: GDPR: if tenant asks to delete data, HMAC doesn't let us find & delete occurrences unless we rotate keys?
Marco: plan: support tenant key rotation + tag logs with key-version. on deletion, we rotate and mutate future HMACs. for historical deletion we scrub logs per retention policy and mark any remaining references as deleted in metadata; legal team will review edgecases.
Sam: any perf impact? computing HMAC per sensitive field at ingest seems OK but we should bench. also surrogate generation must be cheap.
Marco: agreed. prototype middleware that: detects sensitive fields via schema/heuristics, computes field_id, emits telemetry, and optionally adds surrogate for replay endpoints.
Priya: attachments: don't want giant field_ids. use chunked fingerprints (SHA256 per chunk) and store a compact fingerprint list. attach-only fingerprints can enable dedupe/correlation without leaking content.
Katie: console UX: how do we present this to engineers so they understand it's a surrogate, not original?
Marco: console shows: redacted value plus a small gray field_id badge and a 'Show surrogate' action that pops a watermark-stamped surrogate and an audit trail of operations (who requested, key-id, canary flag). Surrogate display should be opt-in per user session.
Juli: we also need a dedicated debug routing pool. If a developer opts into live-debug mode, requests route to a small debug capacity with no sampling, strict quotas, and billing transparency. prevents noisy debug from impacting production.
Sam: tie debug pool to routing: add an X-Debug-Mode header. middleware can honor it and route to debug pool. default off. per-tenant opt-in via console.
Priya: rollout plan idea?
Marco: phased:
- Phase A (telemetry): emit field_id for sensitive fields and redact values (no UI change) — 2 weeks.
- Phase B (console canary): surface field_id and 'surrogate preview' for a subset of tenants — 3 weeks.
- Phase C (debug pool + routing + quotas): enable opt-in debug routing, add X-Debug-Mode header, enforce per-tenant caps and billing tags — 4 weeks.
- Phase D (enterprise audit unredact): extend breakglass with 2-approver flow + ephemeral decryption via KMS audit logs — available to enterprise tenants via contract addendum — 6 weeks.
Katie: metrics to monitor: spike in support tickets asking for raw inputs, uniqueness collisions, surrogate mismatch rate (where surrogate fails to reproduce bug), and debug pool abuse.
Marco: collision risk is extremely low with HMAC_SHA256 but we'll add a monitor that samples potential collisions and alerts if same field_id maps to different field types or differing hashed prefixes.
Juli: runbook for unredact: require ticket id, legal + security approval, TTL-limited decrypt key, and immutable audit log entry. Ops triggers must be human and 2FA protected.
Sam: API impact: add optional request header X-Debug-Mode and optional response metadata keys: X-Fieldline-Id, X-Surrogate-Used. Backwards compatible.
Priya: embedder/embeddings risk: don't pass raw embeddings to logs; instead fingerprint and apply the same fieldline concept to extracted spans.
Katie: docs & SDKs: devex needs a short guide on the console changes, plus an SDK middleware snippet for clients to opt into debug pool via header.
Marco: I'll build a small prototype middleware + console mock + RFC. PR will include perf numbers and a debug pool cost estimate.
OpsBot: deploy-checker: created feature flag "fieldline_debug_preview" on eng-platform.
Marco: I'll open RFC and a canary ticket after prototype. link in thread when available.
Priya: tagging privacy/legal for review @legal-team.
Katie: add customer support blurb explaining surrogates and the audit process.
Sam: I'll test joins on staging once middleware PR lands.
Marco: thanks all, PR incoming.
OpsBot: ticket created: RFC-1751119999-fieldline-replay-safe (https://r.ticket/1751119999).
